name: The Deity Of Jesus
overview: Scripture clearly reveals the deity of Jesus Christ, affirming His eternal existence and divine nature. Isaiah prophesies the coming Messiah as 'The mighty God' and 'The everlasting Father,' emphasizing His divine authority and eternal reign. The Gospel of John identifies Jesus as the Word who was both with God and was God from the beginning, highlighting His preexistence and unity with the Father. Jesus' own declaration 'Before Abraham was, I am' echoes God's self-identification, confirming His divine identity. Furthermore, the recognition of Jesus as 'My Lord and my God' by Thomas affirms His rightful place as God incarnate, inviting believers to trust in His divine works and presence.
